messages:
kevin: Heads-up — we started getting a stream of reports from two tenants after the small routing change this morning. they saw a sudden uptick in 429s and the deprecation banner got pinned for them.
jen: saw the alerts. can you paste the header the SDK sent?
sudhir: DeployBot: rollouts/service-router@v3.2 applied to ~20% traffic at 09:12 UTC :rocket:
kevin: SDK header was `X-RW-Client: 1.0` for the older clients; new clients send `X-RW-Client: 2`. our route-matcher currently treats missing header as v1 and has a quota map that ties v1 tokens to the legacy quota bucket.
alice: so tenants where client-side header is missing got routed to v1 quota and exhausted it quickly?
kevin: exactly. two tenants still have lots of legacy traffic from long-lived mobile SDKs, bucket dropped below threshold and then throttled. console then auto-pinned the deprecation banner because of the throttles.
sudhir: oof. banner pinning is working as designed but it's noisy for tenants who can't upgrade quickly. we discussed a soft-unpin for tenants with active grace exemptions — that wasn't implemented.
jen: proposal: change router to prefer header when present, but when header missing, continue to use tenant affinity rather than assume v1. that avoids immediate quota remap. low-risk toggle behind feature-flag.
alice: i like that. also we should add a short-lived telemetry counter so we can see how many requests would flip if we changed behavior: `router.header_fallback_flip_candidates`. simple metric with tenant tag.
kevin: agree. quick mitigation — revert rollout percentage to 0% for the next hour while we push the flag and the telemetry. can someone flip the rollout? @sudhir?
sudhir: reverting now. DeployBot: rollback rollout/service-router@v3.2 -> v3.1 completed (traffic -> 0%) 09:45 UTC :white_check_mark:
jen: follow-ups: 1) feature-flag + unit tests for header-preference, 2) console: add an option to unpin banners for tenants with active grace exemptions (and log action), 3) create dashboard tile showing tenants with high v1 traffic + pinned banners.
alice: for console change: keep audit trail — admins can unpin but require a reason. we should also show estimated impact (tokens spared) so CS can decide.
kevin: SDK team: can we get a tiny update to emit `X-RW-Client: 2` by default in the next minor release? not blocking but helps long-term.
jen: I'll open a console PR for an "unpin reason" modal and a small dashboard mock. tagging @frontend.
sudhir: creating the feature-flag + telemetry now. I'll add a quick canary so we can see flips on staging.
kevin: thanks. one more ask — add an adhoc log line when header is missing: `router: header_fallback tenant=<tid> candidate=true`. keep it rate-limited. we need to instrument to validate the fix.
jen: noted. also, for messaging UX, let's change the banner copy from "Your clients are deprecated" -> "Some clients are using an older API version; upgrade recommended — contact support if you need extra time." less alarmist.
alice: +1. reduce CS ticket noise.
kevin: timeline: revert done, flag+telemetry in staging by EOD, console mock by tomorrow morning, small SDK ping to mobile leads.
sudhir: will post links to staging dashboard and a quick sampling query here when ready.
kevin: thanks team. huge win to catch this early. :thumbsup:
